STX.last_earnings_summary: Fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ended 3 Jul), reported 28 Jul after the close: revenue $3.63B vs about $3.50B expected (+48.5% YoY) and non-GAAP EPS $5.71 vs $5.10, a beat on both. The fiscal Q1 2027 guide of $4.1B +/- $0.1B revenue and $7.30 +/- $0.20 non-GAAP EPS was far above the EPS consensus of about $5.63. The stock had fallen 8.5% on 28 Jul before the report, then closed +2.3% on 29 Jul ($764.43) and +11.4% on 30 Jul ($851.68). Next report is due about 27-28 Oct 2026.
STX.margin_basis: GAAP, latest quarter (fiscal Q4 2026, ended 3 Jul 2026) vs the same quarter a year earlier (fiscal Q4 2025, ended 27 Jun 2025), from stockanalysis quarterly financials. The company's own press release gives nearly the same: gross margin 52.3% vs 37.4%, operating margin 43.0% vs 23.2%. Direction is sharply up on both. TTM (fiscal 2026) gross margin 45.58%, operating margin 34.65% (press release 45.6% and 33.6%).
STX.customer_concentration: One customer was about 14% of fiscal 2026 revenue (year ended 3 Jul 2026), per the 10-K; it is not named in the text read, and no other customer above 10% was seen. Top-ten share was not found.
STX.insider_lockup_events: No IPO lock-up applies and no secondary, ATM or new convertible was found. Exchangeable notes: redemption notice 11 Jun 2026 for the 3.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2028; on 8 Sep 2026 about $150.5M principal was exchanged, with about $151M paid in cash and 1,647,862 new ordinary shares issued (about 0.7% of 227M shares); no notes remain outstanding (8-K of 9 Sep 2026). Insider selling: only sales, no buys, from 1 Jul to 1 Oct 2026. The rows I could read on MarketBeat sum to about $364M over about 446,000 shares, and with the CFO's 11 Sep sale (confirmed on SEC Form 4, not in the MarketBeat rows) about $406M over about 496,000 shares (about 0.2% of shares); the researcher's $421M / 534,000 was not reproduced exactly. Largest: 15 Sep CEO Mosley 97,889 sh at $772.14 ($75.6M), CFO Romano 49,984 sh ($38.6M), EVP Teh 52,730 sh ($41.2M), EVP Morris 15,466 sh ($11.9M); 11 Sep Romano 50,498 sh at about $820-868 (about $42M) after exercising options, under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 30 Apr 2026 (Form 4s filed 15 Sep); 21 Aug Mosley 18,138 sh ($15.4M); Mosley 30,000 sh on each of 1 Jul ($27.4M), 3 Aug ($24.5M), 1 Sep ($24.5M) and 1 Oct ($27.7M), which looks like a pre-set plan (inference). 8-K of 4 Sep 2026 (Item 5.02): director Shankar Arumugavelu will not stand for re-election at the 2026 AGM; no share event. Buybacks: $125M repurchased in the quarter ended 3 Jul 2026 and $295M in fiscal 2026 per the stockanalysis cash-flow statement (the press release reader gave $176M for the year, unresolved); no new authorization found. No debt raised; about $300M repaid in the latest quarter ($1.4B in fiscal 2026).
STX.one_line_story: A big beat and a far-above-consensus guide on 28 Jul lifted fiscal 2027 and 2028 EPS estimates by about 30% on AI-driven hard-drive demand and sharply wider margins; the stock jumped to about $850 by 30 Jul, slid to a $771.81 close on 15 Sep amid steady executive selling, rebounded to $945.57 on 1 Oct, then fell 10.2% on 2 Oct on a report that Toshiba plans to double drive production and 9.2% on 6 Oct to $805.40 on reports of Toshiba bidding against Seagate for TDK's magnetic-heads business.
STX.gaps: WebSearch was unavailable (session budget of 200 used up), so all checks were direct page fetches; the October Toshiba/TDK story rests on headlines listed on stockanalysis, not on articles read. Valuation, growth, margin, cash-flow and balance-sheet figures were re-read on stockanalysis (the researcher's own source) and all matched; independent cross-checks were the company press release (margins, FCF, cash, EPS), Yahoo (consensus) and SEC filings. Price and market value are the 6 Oct 2026 close ($805.40, $183.14B, down 9.2%), not the 5 Oct close on file ($887.09, about $198.9B); the price-history page shows 5 Oct at $887.09 and 6 Oct at $805.63. Small source differences: year-ago Q4 margins are 36.99% / 23.36% on stockanalysis vs 37.4% / 23.2% in the press release; fiscal 2026 operating margin 34.65% vs 33.6%; total debt $3.90B on stockanalysis vs $3.6B in the release (net debt is -$2.19B or about -$1.9B accordingly); GAAP Q4 EPS $5.57 vs $5.58. The EPS revision pair comes from Yahoo alone (Zacks blocked) and its short end looks stale. Revenue-estimate revision has no then-and-now pair, so it is set to unknown, although the direction is very likely up (current-quarter consensus is now $4.12B, in line with a guide that was above expectations). "Raised" guidance means the quarterly guide was far above consensus and the prior quarter; Seagate gives no full-year guide. The revenue consensus of about $3.7B for fiscal Q1 before the report was not found on any page and was dropped from the summary. eps_growth_next_fy_pct is computed from Yahoo's $35.78 -> $55.37. Fiscal 2026 buybacks: $295M on stockanalysis vs $176M read from the press release, unresolved; remaining authorization and repurchases after 3 Jul 2026 were not found. Insider totals are sums of page rows and may miss filings (a Form 4 for K.F. Chong on 11 Sep was not read). supply_overhang stays true on the record's reasoning (steady executive selling plus 1.65M shares from the note exchange), but both are under 1% of shares combined and the notes are now fully retired, so it is a weak overhang. The 14% customer is unnamed; the 10-K note with prior-year concentration and top-ten share was not reachable. Cause of the +5.53% share-count rise was not confirmed.
